airbnb.name: Airbnb
airbnb.key_insight: Airbnb's design is a masterclass in reducing the trust barrier of the sharing economy — reviews, verified photos, and Superhost badges genuinely solve the 'sleeping in a stranger's home' problem. But the same product that innovated trust also deploys classic conversion dark patterns: manufactured scarcity, fee hiding, and price anchoring. The tension between 'design that builds trust' and 'design that maximizes conversion' is visible in every booking flow. Airbnb's ethical score is middling precisely because it excels at both genuine value creation and subtle manipulation.

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.key_insight: Instagram shows what happens when a product's behavioral design evolves to serve the platform's needs rather than the user's. The original photo-sharing app had natural stopping cues (finite friend posts). The algorithmic feed, infinite scroll, and Reels removed those cues. Instagram's behavioral design is technically brilliant but strategically misaligned — it optimizes for time-spent at the cost of user wellbeing, a trade-off that's becoming increasingly visible (and regulated).
instagram.top_technique: Pull-to-Refresh as Variable Ratio Slot Machine
